name: dac-hub-pro
description: DAC Hub Pro - Transformando o Xiaomi Redmi Go em um Receptor de Áudio DAC Hi-Fi Dedicado (Lossless)

scripts.deploy: powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build_apk.ps1 && .\tools\platform-tools\adb.exe install -r -d -t dist/DAC_Hub_Pro.apk && .\tools\platform-tools\adb.exe shell am force-stop com.dachub.audio && .\tools\platform-tools\adb.exe shell am start -n com.dachub.audio/.MainActivity

author: DAC Hub Pro Team
